purpose: Register three user-added intended likeness references for a separate Comfy face/body swap stage; no design-master promotion.
authorization: User supplied additional likeness reference files; this intake records their actual filenames, image properties, duplicate check and role limits. It does not execute a likeness edit.
naming_note: There are three distinct files, not four: Hon solo_3.jpg, Hon solo_4.jpg and han solo 5.webp. The repeated spoken _3 mention adds no duplicate entry. The fifth filename is WEBP, not JPG. Proposed ledger IDs continue after existing HD-LIKENESS-01/02/03; filename _3 is not the existing HD-LIKENESS-03 crop.

references.role: Single-subject likeness and expression candidate for Comfy face/body swap preparation
references.visual_observations: One adult subject seated in a cockpit-like setting, near-frontal face with slight turn, brown swept hair, open-mouth smile and a raised hand/communication device beside the image-right side of the head. Face is readable but the frame contains substantial clothing, console and background.
references.suggested_use: Best immediately isolated subject among this new batch for an expression/likeness candidate. Compare against the existing isolated HD-LIKENESS-03; use one primary source at a time for the first controlled still edit.
references.use_limits: Likeness/hair/expression only. Smiling mouth and hand near the ear are not a neutral mouth/anatomy standard. Modest resolution and compression limit fine skin/teeth evidence. Original vest, shirt, cockpit and props do not set Hon Dolo wardrobe, tattoos, grill or scene canon.
references.direct_conditioning_note: Single subject is available, but crop/isolation and graph-specific preprocessing should still be declared before use; no crop created in this intake.

references.role: Three-panel likeness comparison sheet; source for a later selected single-panel crop
references.visual_observations: Three side-by-side views: image-left is a wider standing figure with a tilted head, center is a near-frontal chest-up portrait with a restrained closed-mouth smile, and image-right is a cockpit/hand-to-head smiling view visually related to Hon solo_3.jpg. Lighting, clothing, framing and expression differ across panels.
references.suggested_use: Use to compare expression and age direction. The center panel is a candidate for a later single-panel neutral-ish likeness crop, with limited face pixels; the right panel adds little independent pose evidence beyond _3.
references.use_limits: Do not pass the whole triptych as a single face anchor: it contains three faces/views and could introduce duplication or blended expressions. Panel crops would be derived assets with parent hash and exact bounds. Visual overlap with _3 is not a byte-identical file or proof of identical source pixels. No outfit/tattoo/grill authority.

references.role: Two-panel age/era comparison source; isolate one intended age before any Comfy likeness input
references.visual_observations: Two side-by-side wider portraits. Image-left shows a younger-looking adult with dark hair and a closed mouth against a plain light background. Image-right shows an older-looking adult with graying hair and a closed mouth in an outdoor setting. Both carry visible costume/prop context; an Entertainment Weekly mark is present at lower right.
references.suggested_use: Keep as age-direction comparison. If the established younger direction is intended, the image-left panel is a possible future crop; the older image-right panel stays an explicitly separate option. The user's final age/era choice remains unrecorded here.
references.use_limits: Do not feed both panels together and average the ages. Faces occupy only part of a wider body image, so whole-file resolution is not face-detail resolution. Source URL, exact dates and original publication provenance are unknown. Neither panel establishes production costume, props, tattoos or grill; no mark removal or image edit was performed.

duplicate_check.scope: All .jpg/.jpeg/.png/.webp/.gif/.bmp/.tif/.tiff files under D:/Documents/CFA; .git, node_modules, .venv, venv and __pycache__ directories excluded.
duplicate_check.method: Byte-size prefilter followed by full SHA-256 for size matches. Windows extended-length paths used so long received-asset paths were included.
duplicate_check.visual_overlap_note: The right panel of Hon solo_4.jpg is visually related to Hon solo_3.jpg; preserve both as distinct source files. No deletion or consolidation occurred.
